core_categories: Healthcare Contract Logistics; Warehousing; Transport; Supply Chain Management; Value-Added Services; Digital Supply Chain Solutions
specialty_focus: Movianto is a pan-European healthcare contract logistics provider (3PL/4PL) specializing in end-to-end supply chain solutions, temperature-controlled warehousing, and transport for the pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, and diagnostics industries. It operates across 11 European countries and offers services including primary transport, storage, order fulfillment, manufacturing support, financial services, customs management, last mile transport, and supply chain consulting. It does not specifically deal in wearable medical devices but serves the broader medical device sector.
key_brands: Eurotranspharma, Transpharma International, Centre Spécialités Pharmaceutiques (CSP), Walden Digital, others
